add.label: STATUTE

comment: Item 1 only reclassifies the filing as a subsidiaere Verfassungsbeschwerde; item 2 says nicht eingetreten, so outcome = inadmissible (analogous to the vereinigt rule). Extended four statute chains; added one BGE list item. Pre-annotated AMOUNT 'Fr. 50' cut the sum 'Fr. 50 Mio.' in half; I extended it to include 'Mio.'.
